title: Left unitality from representative normalization
statement: Let \(C,D,E,H\) be monoidal categories, \(Q:C\to D\) and \(R:E\to H\) lax monoidal functors, \(F:C\to E\) oplax monoidal, \(S:D\to H\) a functor, and \(r:Q;S\to F;R\) natural. Let \(\delta(X,Y):S(X\otimes Y)\to SX\otimes SY\) be natural in its first variable and let \(\eta:S1_D\to1_H\). Assume \(\delta(QX,QY);(r_X\otimes r_Y);\mu_R(FX,FY)=S(\mu_Q(X,Y));r_{X\otimes Y};R(\delta_F(X,Y))\), and \(S(\epsilon_Q);r_{1_C};R(\eta_F)=\eta;\epsilon_R\). If \(r_X\) is monic, then \(\delta(1_D,QX);(\eta\mathbin{\triangleright}S(QX));\lambda_{S(QX)}=S(\lambda_{QX})\). Semicolon denotes composition in application order; \(\mu,\epsilon\) and \(\delta_F,\eta_F\) are the lax and oplax structural maps. Also define scalarLeftUnitMap to be the natural transformation whose component is the left side of this unit equation, when \(\delta\) is natural in both variables.

proof.text: Tensor the representative unit equation on the left with r_X. Naturality of δ and the tensor representative equation rewrite the first path by ordinary oplax left unitality. Lax left unitality and naturality of the left unitor rewrite the second path as the proposed left-unit composite followed by r_X. Naturality of r identifies the first path with S of the left unitor followed by r_X. Cancel this monomorphism.

theorem leftUnit_on_representative
    {C D E H : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [Category H]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory E] [MonoidalCategory H]
    (Q : C ⥤ D) [Q.LaxMonoidal] (R : E ⥤ H) [R.LaxMonoidal]
    (F : C ⥤ E) [F.OplaxMonoidal] (S : D ⥤ H)
    (r : Q ⋙ S ⟶ F ⋙ R)
    (δ : ∀ X Y : D, S.obj (X ⊗ Y) ⟶ S.obj X ⊗ S.obj Y)
    (η : S.obj (𝟙_ D) ⟶ 𝟙_ H)
    (hδ : ∀ X {Y Z : D} (f : Y ⟶ Z),
      S.map (f ▷ X) ≫ δ Z X = δ Y X ≫ (S.map f ▷ S.obj X))
    (ht : ∀ X Y : C,
      δ (Q.obj X) (Q.obj Y) ≫ (r.app X ⊗ₘ r.app Y) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ R (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) =
      S.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ Q X Y) ≫ r.app (X ⊗ Y) ≫
        R.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F X Y))
    (hu : S.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε Q) ≫ r.app (𝟙_ C) ≫
      R.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η F) = η ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε R)
    (X : C) [Mono (r.app X)] :
    δ (𝟙_ D) (Q.obj X) ≫ (η ▷ S.obj (Q.obj X)) ≫ (λ_ (S.obj (Q.obj X))).hom =
      S.map (λ_ (Q.obj X)).hom
